in_sanskrit.name: महेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mahā-endra, meaning 'great lord of Indra', derived from the Sanskrit words 'mahā' (great) and 'indra' (lord)

in_marathi.name: Mahendr
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahendr हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu god Mahadeva, also known as Shiva. The name means 'great mountain' and symbolizes power, strength, and stability. Mahendra is the lord of mountains, and the name is believed to bring prosperity, courage, and victory.
